sloka: इक्ष्वाकोस्तु प्रसादेन सर्वे वैशालिका नृपाः ।दीर्घ आयुषो महात्मानो वीर्यवन्तः सुधार्मिकाः ॥१-४७-१८॥
transliteration: ikṣvākostu prasādena sarve vaiśālikā nṛpāḥ ।dīrgha āyuṣo mahātmāno vīryavantaḥ sudhārmikāḥ ॥1-47-18॥

translations.english: By the grace of the Ikshvakus, all the kings of Vishala have been long lived and exalted, valiant and deeply religious.
